subject.title: Memory dreaming run pegs the gateway event loop for ~10 min until killed; short-term recall store can never persist (2026.6.9, reproduces on unmodified dist)

question: Should maintainers collect the reporter's process samples and/or run a current-main live reproduction before allowing a fix PR for the memory-core dreaming stall?
rationale: The issue has strong latest-release field evidence, but the exact current-main hot path is still ambiguous and the repository already marks this as needing live repro and maintainer review.

options.title: Collect samples first
options.body: Ask for the v2026.6.11 process sample and config/corpus shape, then identify the specific current-main frame before authorizing code changes.

options.title: Sponsor a targeted fix now
options.body: Allow a maintainer-owned fix attempt against the most suspicious memory-core state/writeback path, accepting that the first patch may miss the real frame.

options.title: Fold into broad gateway work
options.body: Treat this only as a symptom of broader gateway event-loop starvation, which risks losing the memory-core-specific recall-state evidence.

recommendation.title: Collect samples first
recommendation.body: Ask for the v2026.6.11 process sample and config/corpus shape, then identify the specific current-main frame before authorizing code changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue needs maintainer routing across the recent SQLite dreaming-state migration, current-main memory-core state code, and broader gateway responsiveness policy.
